shortDescription: Create a Forgejo runner registration file using forgejo-runner.

options.name: cache_dir
options.description: Directory used to store checksum state for idempotency. If omitted, defaults to C(<working_dir>/.ansible/forgejo-runner).

options.name: runner_file
options.description: Name of the runner file created in I(working_dir).

options.name: runner_name
options.description: Optional override for selecting the matching runner entry. If omitted, the module uses the current host name (short and FQDN forms).

options.name: runners
options.description: List of known runners. Each item must contain C(name), C(secret) and C(instance). C(name) is matched against the host name or I(runner_name).

options.name: use_name_flag
options.description: Try passing C(--name <runner_name>) to the CLI. If the installed forgejo-runner does not support this flag, the module automatically retries without it.

options.name: working_dir
options.description: Directory in which the runner registration file is created. Must exist on the remote host.
